records.text: An unnamed hospital waiting-room interlocutor reportedly predicted that Candace Owens would have an extreme reaction to Charlie Kirk’s death, according to Blake Neff’s quoted recollection.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep FGoeoZxDN1c)
